review.claim: A preparation step (CourseworkPane step button) runs school.prepare: refused by prepareRefusal (no/finished work, not a step, revision before shown, unread feedback, an open partner ask, an open moment on the work, unmet needs (studio/library before the tour, partner), a step's requirement, nothing more to gain (>=0.97), done today, too tired/injured/in hospital for work on the feet, not free for the step's own minutes). Otherwise it takes minutesOf(step), moves a.prep[dim] by gain x focus x trait knob x genre/feature speed x (1-before), counts steps/practicedOn, rehearses a chosen way of playing in (rehearsal/partner dims), trains act.trains on at most 3 steps recorded under 'coursework:<step>' (grewFrom), and grows the PREP_ABILITY ability. The showing at the due meeting (judgeWork; a toned scene judged in its tones via scenePiece), its note (noteCandidates) and the workbook forecast (forecastWork) read it.

defects.summary: The CLASS.amends comment falsifies the rule it documents. It says amends give back what each thing took, and gives a meeting or rehearsal missed as trust 6 and 'the bond 2 of the 3 it cost'. The weekly cap at booking, played: e3-s1 on Monday 14 September 2026 at eight presses Take An Elective Shift on the rendered Work-Study tab eight times. The toasts name Tuesday 15, Wednesday 16 and Thursday 17 September, then Monday 21 to Thursday 24, then Monday 28, each at 7 PM. Summed here from the calendar: the week of the 14th is the assigned Saturday (19 September at ten, six hours) and three evenings, 6 + 3 × 4 = 18, so a fourth (22) would pass 19; the week of the 21st has no assigned Saturday, four evenings, 16, so a fifth (20) would pass 19. Friday to Sunday of both weeks had nothing on the calendar that wants the player from seven to eleven, so the cap alone passed them by. Elective Hours Asked For reads 32. The ninth press toasts nothing; the command is refused ‘No free evening in the next two weeks within Yale’s cap of 19 hours a week in term, across all your Yale jobs.’, with eight electives still booked and electiveHours still 32. Played on to 29 September, all eight are done and no ‘A Shift Over The Weekly Cap’ notice came. This replaces tests/work-limits.test.ts:41-47 (shifts by hand, the message alone) as the cap’s evidence.

review.claim: SHIFT_KIND (booked by planWeek for Saturdays or by take_shift for evenings). Off sick, or with a sick day called in, the shift is missed: an elective gives its hours back, an assigned shift's hours go to excusedHours, which can be converted to grant aid. Over the weekly cap with what's worked, it's missed with a notice and not held against the student. An assigned shift counts tally.shifts. Not registered (I-9), it's missed and not excused. An assigned shift needs the PPE: bought there, or sent home and missed if the bank can't cover it. Present: an assigned shift counts worked, owedHours += hours up to the room left, an injury roll (crew or usher), the payday booked, the student tired. Absent: missed, the elective's hours freed, a notice.

It checks the record's growth and classGrowth agree to 1e-9. Then it splits raw points from pace in both directions on falls the clock plays to the 11 December evaluation. The near fall (0.9 of reach) has raw growth < 0.5 × the class's, but paced ≥ 1.1 × classPace: ahead, good. The far fall (0.4 of reach, class drive 4) has raw growth > 0.5 × the class's, but paced < 0.5 × classPace: behind, concern. For the far fall it asserts attendance 1, under half the pieces unready, no course failed and no run work, so the pace alone is the cause. Both falls draw the reason on the rendered Standing tab. Residual, not a gap: both falls begin at a starting craft, and the far class at a drive, set by hand (TEST SETUP, said so). Everything after is the clock. tools/acceptance-ui.mjs:707 is still outside the gate, but the Standing tab is rendered inside it (b08, g24, evidence3).

The Ask test therefore asserts decideAt 25 December 2026, Christmas Day, and the panel tells the player 'Decided by December 25, 2026'. The third-day journey's 20 January 2027 also counts Monday 18 January, which the engine's own calendar marks as Martin Luther King Jr. Day (CLASSES_2026_27.off). Had that day not been counted, the leave would begin 21 January, past 10% of the spring's classes (10.5 of about 103 days), and return 50%, $7,600.25, not $15,200.50. LEAVE_RULES says the decision comes 'within' five working days, so 20 January is defensible. A decision dated to a holiday is the same class as the Thanksgiving appointment fixed on 2026-10-13 (appointments.ts slot). The reregister journey's hold figure, $15,575.50, inherits this.

gapsClosed: The kept-on-warning case was played, with the 2026-10-13 fix in place. In the first spring Ada slept through four meetings each of DRAM 163b and DRAM 403a/b; DRAM 113a/b failed too, three Fails in all. The faculty's review kept her on warning with the words '...the year is to be repeated, which you ask for at its end.'. The repeat was asked and granted (offset 2), with no 'Your Repeat Is Refused'. The repeated fall's evaluation on 10 December 2027 left her in good standing with one review on record, so she wasn't dismissed on the same Fails.

The nine-semester refusal at the request was reached through play. A first year repeated, the last spring's DRAM 473b slept through, eight enrolled: 'Repeating would make 10 semesters, past the nine the Bulletin allows for the degree.'. The evaluation offered the additional term alone, as Spring Term 2031.

Refusals checked through the command: 'Not with a leave under way.' (a medical leave asked for, TEST SETUP flu); 'The next year has begun.' at 8 AM on 23 August 2027, then 'A year is repeated from its end, after the spring’s evaluation.' at 10 AM and in the first spring; 'Every course this year was passed: there’s nothing to repeat it for.' after the repeated spring; 'Your request is with the chair and the dean, decided by April 30, 2027.'.

The second-time refusal and 'degree reads the best' were reached by play, with no hand-set records or direct calls. Text Analysis I was slept through again in the repeated spring and the request gave 'SLATE’s faculty don’t approve year 1 a second time.'. The record 1:DRAM 163b fail sits beside 3:DRAM 163b pass, both against program term 1, and the Standing tab says 'Only the terms to come stand between you and the degree.'.

'Courses meeting again' is no longer just academicTerm. Fall Term 2027 holds a record for each of the first year's nine fall courses (codes listed literally), each against program term 0, met and passed. The first attempts remain, and 'The Class Of 2030' notice came.

Render: Ask To Repeat The Year… is drawn first. The asked panel (TEST SETUP: the choice pressed) says 'Asking puts it to the chair and the dean, decided in five working days. Granted, you take year 1’s courses again from Fall Term 2027...'. Pressing Ask runs the command, with the toast 'Asked: decided by April 30, 2027.'. The decision came through a save: granted at 6 PM on 30 April, offset 2, class of 2030, one notice, and repeatedYears [1] once.

The weak test is replaced by exact words through the command. The life was born in London, with Movement Invention III failed in Fall 2028. With an additional term asked (decided 4 May 2029 at 6 PM): 'Your request for an additional term is with the chair and the dean, decided by May 4, 2029.'. Once granted (Fall Term 2029, Movement Invention III alone): 'Your additional term is Fall Term 2029.', no repeat recorded, offset 0, class of 2029, no REPEAT_DECIDE_KIND. Without the school.extra line the refusal would have been 'Your last year’s evaluation is past.', which is what mutation 3a showed. RepeatPanel, drawn with Ask To Repeat The Year… pressed, drew no Ask and said where the additional term stood. The twin with neither was let ask (decided 4 May).

The decision's refusals, reached through the clock from a fixture beside a twin that is granted. A first year: 'Your Repeat Is Refused' with 'The chair and the dean refused it. 2 courses failed in Spring Term 2027: the Bulletin disqualifies a student with 2 Failures in a term.'; offset 0, class of 2029, nothing withheld, and Fall 2027's term still on the calendar for 23 August at 9 AM. A last year: withheld at 6 PM on 4 May 2029 with 'The chair and the dean refused your request to repeat the year. … The faculty didn’t recommend the degree, and your terms at the School are over.'; no term on the calendar, and the I-20 as it was where the twin's went to 2030-07-30.

A Fail’s notice told every student ‘at the year’s end you can ask to repeat the year’, even in a year already repeated, where repeatRefusal refuses a second time. It now offers that only where the year can still be repeated. (Until the second round that meant a year not in repeatedYears; since then, a year with room in the nine semesters as the year’s end counts them, which takes in a year repeated.)

A Fail at an evaluation that dismissed the student (the faculty’s review, or the warning unmet) or withheld the degree was still told to ask to repeat the year at its end, which “You’re not at school.” then refused: the notice was said in settleCourses, before the evaluation read the Fails. It is said by tellFails after the evaluation settles the standing, with the School’s ending read, and so after the standing’s own notice at the same instant.

A Permanent Incomplete in a year repeated once already was told to ask to repeat the year. It isn’t now: until the second round by a `repeated` check, since then by the count of semesters (`repeatOpen`, as `tellFails`).

After any repeat granted, a Fail or a Permanent Incomplete in any later year, at an evaluation that ended nothing, was still told to ask to repeat the year at its end, which “Repeating would make 10 semesters…” refused: the notices excluded only the year itself being repeated. They now read repeatRoom, the count as the year’s end will make it: those enrolled, the program’s terms still to be taken through that spring (the spring at a fall’s evaluation, the year’s two again after a repeat is granted), the year’s two again and the terms after (withRepeat). The caller’s first version counted those enrolled so far, which at a second fall’s evaluation after a first year’s repeat made nine and still offered; the terms to come were added on 2026-10-15. The `repeatedYears` clause in repeatOpen was then redundant (enrolled is the program terms taken plus two per repeat granted, so the count is 8 plus 2 per repeat) and was removed.

gapsClosed: DEFECT 1, fixed on 2026-10-13 and held here. On 6 January 2027 an aid student with nothing excused is refused with 'No hours to convert at January’s processing: only assigned hours missed ill or hurt count then.'. The drawn button is disabled with that title, the stat reads '0 hours' and '$0.00 at the rate; 0 converted', and nothing is booked.
DEFECT 2, held. Not asked in May, in June the next processing is January's: refused in the January words, the stat '0 hours', nothing booked.
DEFECT 3 (display), held. On 1 February, with 96 of 150 assigned hours booked, the stat reads '0 hours', where 54 was shown before the fix. The refusal is 'No hours to convert yet: ...'.

The May processing of hours never assigned. All 24 assigned Saturdays of six hours were booked and worked (144), so 150 − 144 = 6 hours. The drawn stat showed '6 hours' and '$138.00 at the rate; 0 converted'. Pressing the button gave the toast 'Asked: processed May 15, 2027.' and booked May 15 at noon. Through a save the grant was exactly $138.00: the account +$138.00 and income:Scholarship −$138.00, two postings, the year's scholarship +$138.00 exactly, convertedHours {0: 6}, and one notice naming the account. Nothing came twice.

The January excused path. An assigned Saturday was called in sick (TEST SETUP flu), giving excusedHours {0: 6}. The press gave the toast 'Asked: processed January 15, 2027.' and the button was then disabled 'Your request is in, for the next processing.'. On 15 January at noon postings of +$138.00 and −$138.00 were made and the scholarship rose $138.00 exactly. This replaces the permissive >= of work-limits.test.ts:95.
The tax return. The 2027 return filed in February 2028 (tax.file) shows a scholarship and an income each $138.00 more than a twin that didn't ask.

Nonresident withholding (born in London): $138.00 with 14% withheld, so $118.68 to the account and $19.32 to Tax Withheld. The year's withholding rose by $19.32, and the notice says ', $19.32 withheld for tax.'.

Refusals through the command: 'Conversion to grant aid is for students on financial aid, and no need was found for you.' (the new life's wealthy family; the stat reads 'Not On Aid') and 'Not while on leave: a student on leave has no aid.'. A medical leave begun mid-term with a request pending cancelled it, and nothing was paid in January.

Returned hours are paid hours. On 3 May 2027, with 144 of 150 assigned hours booked, the stat said '6 hours' and '$138.00 at the rate; 0 converted', and school.request_conversion returned {at: 15 May 2027 at noon, hours: 6}. The processing paid exactly those six: 'Grant-in-aid: 6 work-study hours converted, David Geffen School of Drama at Yale University', $138.00 to the account, the year's scholarship up $138.00, convertedHours {0: 6}.

No need for a creation-screen life, played. newLifeFrom, given a draft asking for family unset and wealth 'scraping', made a wealthy life. Its first assigned Saturday (5 September 2026, six hours) was called in sick, giving 6 hours excused and the stat '6'. The drawn button was grayed with 'Conversion to grant aid is for students on financial aid, and no need was found for you.', the stat said 'Not On Aid', and the command was refused in those words. Nothing was booked and nothing paid on 15 January 2027. The same life with need (TEST SETUP) was paid -$138.00/+$138.00 for the same six hours.
'No Hours To Convert', from a fixture: the notice in its words, no grant, no 'Hours Converted' notice, and the request done at noon on 15 May. The twin was paid.

‘Every accepted path is reached only by a life with need, which no player can have’ no longer holds from 2026-10-14. The family select’s own change for Scraping gives { …newLifeConfig(), family: undefined, wealth: 'scraping' }, equal to evidence-g26’s and evidence2-b09’s ON_AID config, and createSave from each of their seeds (g26-paid, g26-c0, g26-c1, g26-c2 born in London, g26-c3, b09-c0) gives the same universe to the byte from either. So the January excused path, the May never-assigned path, the 2027 return, the nonresident’s withholding, the refusals and the leave calling a request off in those files are lives the screen makes.

Played here besides, on e3-c1, born in London, Scraping chosen on the screen: the first assigned Saturday (5 September 2026) called in sick, ‘6 hours’ and ‘$138.00 at the rate; 0 converted’ on the drawn panel, Ask pressed (‘Asked: processed January 15, 2027.’); on 15 January at noon $138.00 with 14%, $19.32, withheld: $118.68 to Chase Total Checking, the year’s withholding up $19.32, the notice ‘…, $19.32 withheld for tax. …’. On 3 May, 144 of 150 assigned hours booked, the stat ‘6 hours’ and ‘6 converted’; Ask pressed (‘Asked: processed May 15, 2027.’), through a save paid the same, convertedHours {0: 12}, the notice brought up to 15 May once; the year’s scholarship $14,290.00 (the spring’s taxable $14,014.00 and two grants) and withholding $2,000.60 ($1,961.96, 14% of $14,014.00, and $19.32 twice). The 2027 1040-NR filed in February 2028 carries $276.00 more scholarship and income and $38.64 more withheld than a twin who never asked. A twin who asked and then began a medical leave (TEST SETUP flu) had the request called off, was refused ‘Not while on leave: a student on leave has no aid.’, and was paid nothing on 15 January.

Refused in words for permission, SAG-AFTRA’s 30th day, another booking or a School call held in summer; in term the School’s warning is said first.

items.entry: Career, Work, Your Unions: Join SAG-AFTRA ($3,244.07) (WorkPane.tsx:173), grayed with joinSagRefusal’s words; opened by the tutorial’s “Your Career” (tutorial.ts:475); registered by propay.ts:739 (from 2026-10-21)
items.reads: joinSagRefusal (propay.ts:690): not a member already; eligible from a first SAG-AFTRA principal role’s first day (a network drama or a Low Budget film, SAG_QUALIFIES, set by the SAG_ELIGIBLE handler, propay.ts:721, and the work day’s unionsFrom, projobs.ts:1163); the bank covering the initiation fee and half a year’s base dues
items.changes: The fee through payFromBank (category dues), membership from now (pro.sag.memberSince), and the next half-year’s base dues billed (addBill, duesBill) (propay.ts:739-749)
items.downstream: sagWorkRefusal (propay.ts:682) lifts the 30th day’s refusal at acceptance (acceptRefusal, projobs.ts:724); duesOn (propay.ts:377) takes 1.575% working dues from SAG-AFTRA pay; the base dues billed each May and November (DUES handler, propay.ts:715); the résumé lists SAG-AFTRA (resumeNow, pro.ts:769), which makes the current one behind
items.explanation: The toast; Your Unions on the Work tab; the notice You Can Join SAG-AFTRA; the guide’s Your Unions (guide/career.ts:567)
items.tests: tests/journey-career.test.ts ‘Join SAG-AFTRA after her first SAG-AFTRA principal job began: refused before it with its reason, $3,244.07 taken once...’ (life A: eligible on the first day of the network part booked through him, refused before it with its reason, joined that evening, $3,244.07 taken once, SAG-AFTRA’s working dues of $48.58 taken from that job’s pay in trust, half a year’s base dues billed and taken at the November billing beside Equity’s, and the résumé made after she joined reading SAG-AFTRA); tests/propay.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a first SAG-AFTRA principal job makes the actor eligible on its first day...’ (refused before eligibility in its words, eligible by the clock on the job’s first day, $3,244.07 from the bank, the 30th day’s refusal lifted by calling sagWorkRefusal after it, refused once a member, across a reload); ‘refuses Join SAG-AFTRA where the bank can’t cover it, and nothing is charged’ (the money taken out by hand); tests/propay-screen.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a graduate with no work booked reads that work appears here...’ and ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: in a guided life, the Work tab and Join SAG-AFTRA stay shut until...’ (rendered, grayed with why; Locked); tests/pro-work.test.ts ‘GUARD: from the 30th day after a first SAG-AFTRA job began, a SAG-AFTRA role is refused at acceptance until the actor joins...’ (acceptRefusal called on an offer and membership set by hand)
items.issue: Added on 2026-10-21 (brief 19’s audit, docs/verification/career-2026-10-20/audit/REPORT.md), traced until then in docs/verification/connected-journey/TRACE.md alone, and read that day against 7bbab80f by a reader who wrote neither the code nor its tests, and again the same day against a483247d, once V1’s journeys had landed, and a third time against c01e06f4, once tests had been written for what the second reading found missing; its mutations are in docs/verification/career-2026-10-20/audit/mutations.txt. At 7bbab80f it was partial, for two gaps: its eligibility came in every test from an engagement written by hand with its pay put on the clock by calling schedulePay (booked in tests/fakes/career-work.ts), though SAG-AFTRA’s qualifying work takes submissions only from agents; and what joining changes afterward was read by no test, mutations P3 (no member’s working dues) and P4 (no base dues billed on joining) each surviving every test of the pay, the Work tab and the work loop. From a483247d life A of tests/journey-career.test.ts plays both: the network part his breakdowns brought makes her eligible on its first day, she joins through the command, its working dues come out of that job’s pay and the base dues it billed are taken in November. Mutations Q9 (M21 again), Q12 (P3 again) and Q13 (P4 again) each failed it. The 30th day’s refusal is lifted only by calling sagWorkRefusal after the command (tests/propay.test.ts). At a483247d it stayed partial for a reader no test read, found by the second reading: the résumé lists SAG-AFTRA for a member (resumeNow), which makes the one before behind, and with that line taken out (mutation Q14) every test of the portfolio, the pay and both lives passed. From c01e06f4 life A’s résumé, made by Update Your Résumé after she joined, is read for SAG-AFTRA and not SAG-AFTRA Eligible (tests/journey-career.test.ts); Q14 run again (R1) failed it.

review.claim: Join SAG-AFTRA, once a first SAG-AFTRA principal role makes the actor eligible, takes the initiation fee and half a year’s base dues from the bank and makes them a member: SAG-AFTRA work from the 30th day is no longer refused, its pay has working dues taken, and base dues are billed each May and November. Refused before eligibility, once a member, and with the bank short, charging nothing.

findings.what: Coursework showings (band/overall, repeated Unready work, missed or lapsed assignments) never reach the term evaluation or standing; only that meeting's 0.85-1.2 growth weight. Teachers' notes read craft growth only. Repeated unprepared coursework produces "Still There" notes, never concern/warning.
findings.evidence: evaluate reads tally, termGrowth, casting/rep nights, breaches; no read of coursework.assignments or person.work
findings.suggestedFix: Fold the term's showings (mean overall or share Unready/missed) into evaluate() as run nights are, or say in the evaluation text that coursework is not weighed

findings.what: The Carlotta run (every first-year spring, lower half in second-year spring) plays 4-12 May, after the spring evaluation on the last class day (23 Apr); its nights are never read by any evaluation. Its missed calls land in a tally already evaluated and reset next term.
findings.evidence: run filter c.term===term && nights>=3 at evaluation time; CLASSES spring to 2027-04-23; carlotta [[5,4],[5,12]]
findings.suggestedFix: Evaluate after the term's production closes, or carry a run closing after the evaluation into the next term's

findings.what: Development history misses much growth: playNight/rehearse (every call and night), lab growth, a coursework step's trained skill (grow), and nerves' composure/presence nudges. The Profile look says "Nothing has moved it since the history began" for e.g. composure or classical that did move. These paths also bypass develop()'s same-day repeat and discipline lift.
findings.evidence: grow() and nudge() write craft/attrs directly, no recordDevelopment
findings.suggestedFix: Route through develop()/ordinary() or call recordDevelopment with the delta

findings.what: The director's run note "Work on your X" sets noteSkill/noteLevel, and cast() computes heeded and LastWork.nights, but castScore reads neither and nothing else does. SchoolWorkspace tells the player "How a run goes is read by the chair when casting you next" while the chair reads delivery (prep x condition), not the nights.
findings.evidence: heeded/lastWork.nights read only in tests (attributes-complete.test.ts:80, casting.test.ts:220)
findings.suggestedFix: Drop heeded/nights/noteSkill/noteLevel or give them a reader; reword the UI line to delivery

findings.what: Classmate.shown (classmateRun's judged quality) is written and read by nothing; a classmate's LastWork.delivery is their static reliability, not the run.
findings.evidence: only writer school.ts:1455; attributes-complete.test.ts:107-108 asserts only that it exists
findings.suggestedFix: Use the run's quality/delivery for their next casting, or remove the record

findings.what: Cabaret, Summer Cabaret and Rep runs accumulate nights and delivered, but cast() builds lastWork only from school.casting and evaluate() reads only casting/rep, so Cabaret/Summer quality reaches neither standing nor casting.
findings.evidence: c0 = school.casting only; run search [casting, rep]
findings.suggestedFix: Decide whether extracurricular runs count; if not, stop accumulating delivered on them

findings.what: school.filmed is set at graduation and read nowhere (what read it went 2026-10-09).
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or wire to a reader

findings.what: revision.band is kept "for the showcase (showcaseSceneSeen)", which no longer exists; Showing.score and Showing.parts are unread too. Present-tense comments falsified (also school.ts:542 "read by the showcase").
findings.evidence: grep showcaseSceneSeen: comment only; no reader of shown.score/parts/revision.band
findings.suggestedFix: Past-tense the comments; drop or display the fields

findings.what: A night is judged after its own playNight growth, so each performance is evaluated on craft the night itself just added.
findings.evidence: playNight(...) precedes reckonNight(...) in each branch

findings.what: The third year's solo showing (You Are The Creator) is never judged: no evaluation, band or work record, only scene growth.
findings.evidence: showing branch: nerves, grow, tire, return
findings.suggestedFix: Judge it with the scene/performance profile and record it

findings.what: Test name contradicts behavior: casting.test.ts "balances opportunity ... and good nights for it" asserts nights no longer count.

Untested behavior: school.respond choices (trust/bond/answers/tryBoth/boundary), school.read_feedback's gate on prepare, school.moment lapse, study_session effect, classmates' ability growth in class (growMateAbility).
findings.evidence: only journey tests call them, without asserting effects
findings.suggestedFix: Add mutation-sensitive tests for each effect
